# n8n workflow templates

Tested n8n workflow templates from [then8nblog.com](https://then8nblog.com), an independent blog about n8n. Each one was built and run end to end on a real n8n instance before it was published, and each folder has the workflow JSON plus a link to the full guide.

| Template | Tested on | Credentials | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [n8n error workflow: a daily Telegram digest of failed runs](n8n-error-workflow-digest) | n8n 2.39.8 | Telegram API | [Guide](https://then8nblog.com/templates/n8n-error-workflow-digest) |
| [Website uptime monitor in n8n with Telegram alerts](website-uptime-monitor) | n8n 2.39.8 | Telegram API | [Guide](https://then8nblog.com/templates/website-uptime-monitor) |

## How to use a template

1. Open the template's folder and download `workflow.json`.
2. In n8n, open a new workflow and paste the JSON onto the canvas, or use **Import from File** in the workflow menu.
3. Add your own credentials and read the guide for setup steps and limits.

New templates appear here automatically when they're published on [then8nblog.com/templates](https://then8nblog.com/templates).
